summary: Tested backend and frontend for the new Result Analysis meters (journey/confidence/historical-rank), My Tests (progress/saved/completed), bookmarks, side-by-side comparison and report priorities. New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_my_tests_journey.py has 12 tests, all passing, with lots of assertions. The fixtures use real exam shapes: JEE 75 (20 MCQ + 5 integer per subject), BITSAT 130+12 bonus and COMEDK 180. One test goes through the real preflight→start→submit→grade path. Regression test_manual_solve_reports.py passed 19/19. The UI was checked at 1920x800 and 390x844 using synthetic restricted QA sets plus 3 real start/answer/submit JEE full-mock attempts. Everything was cleaned up afterwards. Data was preserved before and after: 144 sets, 11800 questions, same hash, 5939 ready and 1161 paused solutions, no saved papers, no reports, credentials unchanged, no LLM calls. No functional defects found. The problems are visual/typography issues and minor polish.

minor.issue: Returns 500 KeyError 'receipt' (attempts.py line 408) for a completed attempt with no 'receipt' field and no ledger. Real attempts are not affected because finalize always sets receipt. It only happens for legacy or imported completed docs without a receipt. Use a.get('receipt').

Matches with $expr over a computed $concat, so it does a full collection scan on every request. This is fine at the current size (0 real reports) but it will not scale. Consider storing group_id at insert time with an index.
Every card fires its own GET /api/my/tests/saved/{id} (N+1 requests per list page). Consider returning a saved flag in the catalogue response or adding a batch endpoint.

ui_bugs.component: LearningMeters AccuracyGauge / ConfidenceView facts, AttemptComparison values, SetDetail stats
ui_bugs.issue: Numbers in 'Roboto Mono' render visibly tiny or illegible in Chromium: the '66%' in the gauge centre, the '165 / 250' and '90%' facts, '75 / 180 / 300' on SetDetail. This happens even though the computed font-size is 40px/26px. RCA: Roboto Mono is never loaded (index.html only loads Inter 600 and index.css only imports @fontsource/figtree), so it falls back to the generic monospace. In the '165 / 250' fact the digits look tiny while the '/' is large. Fix: add @fontsource/roboto-mono (400/600/700) imports or use Figtree tabular-nums, then re-check the screenshots.

issues: Card eyebrows 'YOUR BITS PATHWAY' and 'YOUR ENGINEERING PATHWAY' are dark text on the dark green/blue card and almost invisible. The JEE eyebrow also has low contrast. Use a white or 75%-opacity white eyebrow.
The corner label '01 / YOUR NEXT CHAPTER' is misleading on an exam chooser card (it is not a chapter).
The '100% free for all students' pill sits about 15px below the baseline of the 'My Tests' button next to it (misaligned row).

Neither Y axis has a title. The left axis is marks and the right axis is accuracy %, and only the legend tells them apart. The request asked for clearly labelled left/right axes: add 'Score (marks)' and 'Accuracy (%)' axis labels.
The X axis shows only the index 1..N. Add a short date or a 'Mock #' label.
The rank-unavailable reason paragraph is set in monospace at about 18px, which makes long prose hard to read. Use the body font.
The platform cohort can show '#1 Among 1 comparable first-attempt profiles'. A sample of 1 is technically honest but adds no meaning; consider hiding it below a minimum sample.
In comparison-headings, the eyebrow, title and date run together on one line ('EARLIER ATTEMPTTEST_..9/22/2026'). They need to be stacked or spaced.
Dates use toLocaleDateString() (US m/d/yyyy) while the cards use en-IN; make the format consistent.
From/To use the native browser <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than a shadcn Calendar/Popover, which is inconsistent with the rest of the UI.
Pluralisation: '1 saved papers in this view' and Studio '1profiles'.

action_items: Load Roboto Mono (e.g. @fontsource/roboto-mono 400/600/700 in index.css) or switch numeric styles to Figtree with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums, then re-verify the gauge, confidence facts, comparison and SetDetail numbers at 1920 and 390.
Raise the contrast of the home exam-card eyebrows (BITSAT/COMEDK nearly invisible) and replace the '0N / YOUR NEXT CHAPTER' corner copy; align the free pill with the My Tests button.
Add Y-axis titles (left: Score (marks), right: Accuracy (%)) and a better X label to the journey LineChart.
Fix the layout of the comparison-headings block (eyebrow/title/date stacked) and use an en-IN date format.
Optional hardening: a.get('receipt') in the attempts.py results grading branch; index or precompute group_id for report groups; batch the saved-state lookups on discovery lists.
Minor copy: pluralisation ('1 saved paper', '1 profile').
critical_code_review_comments: learning_progress.journey: when a stored progress_family matches the key, the candidate is trusted without re-checking parent_attempt/competition. That is safe today because insert_attempt computes family() from the same doc and family() returns None for retries/competitions, so those are stored as null and excluded by the query.

learning_progress.journey runs two scans of up to 500 candidates and hydrates legacy rows (unpack) per request. That is OK for current volume; caching progress_family on legacy rows after reconciliation would avoid repeated unpacking.

my_tests.history_item: compare_eligible does not require the same exam family; the backend compare endpoint correctly enforces paper_basis. The UI allows selecting across pages, and the selection persists across tab/filter changes, which can confuse users. Consider clearing the selection on tab change.
Profile.js and the other new files are compact one-line JSX. They are hard to review, though not over the 700-line limit.
test_credentials: Owner from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (not copied). Students: 9900000196 (primary) and 9900000197 (secondary QA profile for foreign/ownership checks; phone-only, no password). No credentials created or changed.

Verified after cleanup: 144 sets / 11800 questions, same sha, 0 saves, 0 reports, 0 TEST_JR rows. Audit-log entries from the 'Question report reviewed' test actions remain in tejas_audits (append-only log; not deleted on purpose).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_my_tests_journey.py -p no:asyncio -n0 (must be -n0; xdist breaks the session fixtures). It cleans up itself and asserts preservation. For UI fixtures: cd backend/tests && python seed_ui_journey.py seed && python seed_ui_real_attempts.py, then test, then python seed_ui_journey.py cleanup. Synthetic completed attempts without a receipt cannot open /results (500 KeyError); use the real attempts from seed_ui_real_attempts.py for Results UI. Student phones are stored as '+91XXXXXXXXXX' (allowed_phones must use that). Previously verified in the UI: five distinct coloured result tabs (maroon/amber/emerald/sapphire/crimson); heatmap of 75 cells → click opens the matching solution with ?question=, next/prev keep the view; 25 insights in 5 groups; journey 10 points with weighted last-5 165/250=66% and latest 90% shown separately; rank unavailable with an official source checked in 2026 and the cohort shown separately; My Tests counts/filters/pagination/expired/embargo/grading states; comparison works and the 3rd checkbox is disabled; Save toast 'Saved to My Tests. No timer started.' and removal from the saved tab; Studio groups ordered 3/2/1 profiles and a group disappears after its reports are resolved. No horizontal overflow at 390 on home, My Tests or results.
rca of the issue: Tiny numbers: 'Roboto Mono' is referenced in index.css (--font-mono), App.css and learning-workspace.css but no font file is ever loaded (no @fontsource/roboto-mono, no Google link for it), so the browser falls back to the generic monospace and digits render much smaller than the computed 40px/26px suggests. /results 500: attempts.py results() reads a['receipt'] directly in the not-yet-graded branch.
